contea di ritrovamento: Somerset (Inghilterra e Galles)

Roman plated copy of a silver denarius combining aspects of coins of Septimus Severus and Caracalla. The obverse portrait is of Septimius Severus with the legend [ ] AVGVSTVS. The full reading of AVGVSTVS is normally only found on the silver of Caracalla (RIC IV, cf. 50).
